items.description: 16-bit MASM application for DOS featuring bidirectional Morse translation via vector look-up tables. Implements real-time audio beep synthesis using hardware interrupts, an adjustable speed configuration driven by dynamic INT 15H delays, and a rolling memory history cache powered by low-level REP MOVSB string primitives.
